# Pauhu Web Search

> Web answers that cite the page they came from, with its version date where the publisher gives one and the retrieval time. Each answer names its source so you can check it. Reading is free; backend access requires a free Pauhu developer key.

- [Developer key](https://pauhu.dev/developer-terms/): free, 90 days, 50 requests a day, at most 5 a minute
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for AI agents
- [server.json](server.json): MCP remote server
- [Skill](skills/pauhu-developer-key/SKILL.md)
